BEFORE THE ADJUDICATING OFFICER
SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA
MUMBAI BENCH, MAHARASHTRA

UNDER SECTION 15-I OF SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA ACT, 1992 READ WITH RULE 5 OF SEBI (PROCEDURE FOR HOLDING INQUIRY AND IMPOSING PENALTIES) RULES, 1995.

In respect of:
1. Reliance Infrastructure Advisory Pvt Ltd
2. Shri Rajesh Agrawal
3. Apex Securities LLP

In the matter of Illiquid Stock Options at BSE.

1. The Securities and Exchange Board of India (hereinafter referred to as "SEBI") observed large scale reversal trades in illiquid stock options.
2. The Noticees engaged in synchronized reversal trades in options contracts of various underlying scrips without genuine commercial intent, violating Regulations 3(a), (b), (c), (d), 4(1) and 4(2)(a) of SEBI (Prohibition of Fraudulent and Unfair Trade Practices relating to Securities Market) Regulations, 2003 (PFUTP Regulations, 2003).
3. Therefore, in exercise of powers conferred under Section 15-I of SEBI Act read with Rule 5 of Adjudication Rules, I hereby impose a monetary penalty of Rs. 25,00,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Lakhs only) on the Noticees under Section 15HA of the SEBI Act, 1992.
4. The Noticees shall remit the total penalty amount within 45 days of receipt of this order.

Date: March 15, 2024
Place: Mumbai
Adjudicating Officer, SEBI
